title: Enhancing Support for Individual Developer Ecosystem, Alipay Upgrades AI Payment Developer Incentive Program

content_html:
As the core energy of the AI era, Token has long become a necessary resource for AI development.

To better assist developers in achieving commercialization in the AI era and accelerate the development of the intelligent entity commercial ecosystem, Alipay has recently upgraded its AI payment developer incentive program, continuing to provide AI developers with a maximum Token special subsidy of 5660 yuan, and further expanding the scope of incentives and lowering the participation threshold for developers.

From now until August 21, individual developers who integrate any one of Alipay's AI payment products— "AI Pay-per-Use", "AI Web Application Payment", or "AI Mobile Application Payment" during Vibe Coding will unlock tiered incentives based on the number of cumulative effective transaction users.

The incentive program focuses on supporting three core payment products, comprehensively covering developers' diversified and high-frequency commercial scenarios:

1. AI Web Application Payment: It provides payment capabilities suitable for computer websites and mobile web scenarios. Developers can quickly integrate it with a single command through Skill, making the process more simplified and integration more lightweight, while also supporting personal payments.

2. AI Mobile Application Payment: Designed for mobile applications on iOS, Android, and HarmonyOS, developers can quickly access payment capabilities with a single command through Skill, suitable for app internal consumption scenarios such as e-commerce shopping, membership top-up, online ticket booking, local life services, and digital content purchases.

3. AI Pay-per-Use: It allows developers' APIs, digital content, or computing resources to directly initiate automatic payments to the AI agents that access them, eliminating inefficient monthly subscription models and enabling accurate billing and settlement based on usage volume.

Additionally, individual developers using Alipay's "AI Pay-per-Use" can enjoy a 0 fee rate promotion until December 31, 2026.

content_html_zh:
Token作为AI时代的核心能源，早已成为AI发展的必备资源。

为更好地协助开发者在AI时代实现商业化，加速智能实体商业生态发展，支付宝近期升级了AI支付开发者激励计划，继续为AI开发者提供最高5660元的Token专项补贴，并进一步扩大激励范围，降低开发者参与门槛。

即日起至8月21日，个人开发者在Vibe Coding期间集成支付宝任意一款AI支付产品——“AI按次付费”、“AI网页应用支付”、“AI手机应用支付”，将根据累计有效交易用户数解锁分级激励。

激励计划重点支持三大核心支付产品，全面覆盖开发者多元化、高频次的商业场景：

1. AI Web应用支付：提供适合电脑网站和移动Web场景的支付能力。 开发者可以通过Skill用单个命令快速集成，使流程更加简化，集成更加轻量，同时还支持个人支付。

2. AI移动应用支付：针对iOS、Android、鸿蒙等移动应用而设计，开发者通过Skill一指令即可快速接入支付能力，适用于电商购物、会员充值、在线订票、本地生活服务、数字内容购买等应用内部消费场景。

3. AI按使用付费：允许开发者的API、数字内容或计算资源直接向接入它们的AI代理发起自动支付，消除低效的包月模式，并根据使用量实现准确的计费和结算。

此外，在2026年12月31日之前，使用支付宝“AI按用付费”的个人开发者还可享受0手续费优惠。
